title: IDTA Submodel Templates for the Asset Administration Shell
usedFor: Candidate semanticIds for our AAS submodel templates — nameplate, carbon footprint, technical data, digital product passport metadata — the standard identifiers we would adopt if correspondence with our own submodels were established.
source: https://github.com/admin-shell-io/submodel-templates (published/ folder structure) and IDTA's own specification PDFs at industrialdigitaltwin.org, read directly for this record: IDTA-02006-3-0 (Digital Nameplate) and IDTA-02023 v1.0, March 2025 (Carbon Footprint).
finding: Five identifiers were coined for this project's submodel templates and removed on 2026-07-29 for not matching the scheme IDTA actually publishes under. IDTA's real semanticIds are name-based and versioned — confirmed directly against the published/ folder structure (e.g. published/Digital_nameplate/3/0/1) and the specification PDFs themselves — not the document-number form the removed identifiers used. Per template: (1) Digital Nameplate's real identifier is https://admin-shell.io/idta/nameplate/3/0/Nameplate (v3.0), not the removed https://admin-shell.io/IDTA/02006/2/0. (2) The Handover Documentation template (IDTA 02004) has no established real identifier here — the removed https://admin-shell.io/IDTA/02004/1/2/Manufacturer additionally invented a '/Manufacturer' path segment no publication uses. (3) Carbon Footprint's current identifier, verified directly against the IDTA-02023 v1.0 (March 2025) specification PDF, is https://admin-shell.io/idta/CarbonFootprint/CarbonFootprint/1/0 — a newer release than even the pattern the removed https://admin-shell.io/IDTA/02023/0/9 guessed at. (4) IDTA 02011 is 'Generic Frame for Technical Data for Industrial Equipment in Manufacturing', not a physical-properties template — the removed https://admin-shell.io/IDTA/02011/1/0 misidentified the template itself, independent of its URI form; ZVEI's Technical Data submodel (https://admin-shell.io/ZVEI/TechnicalData/Submodel/1/2) was named as the actual candidate. (5) No 'urn:idta:' scheme is published; the removed urn:idta:aas:submodel:digital-product-passport:1.0 used one IDTA does not, where IDTA-02099-1 'Digital Product Passport – Part 1: Metadata' declares https://admin-shell.io/idta/cds/dppMetadata/1. None of these five is adopted: correcting the URI form is not the same as establishing that a template's field set corresponds to what our submodel carries, and that correspondence was never checked for any of them.
nextStep: For each of the five candidate templates above, compare its declared field set against the corresponding Odal Node submodel. Where they correspond, this becomes the first verified entry for this authority; where they do not, an honest urn:odal-node: identifier stays the right choice.
